Serve as the principal liaison between NGO partners and the Sector Coordination Team between monthly sector meetings, facilitating timely two-way communication, follow-up on agreed actions and escalation of operational or strategic issues to the LSDS Coordinator. Support inclusive consultations with partners on strategic priorities, needs and skills assessments, response analysis, geographical and activity prioritization, advocacy positions, and JRP planning and review processes. Strengthen camp-level coordination by facilitating NGO engagement with Camp-in-Charge offices and relevant government counterparts, identifying implementation gaps and overlaps, and referring sensitive or policy-level matters to the LSDS Coordinator. job_description: Oriental Group is looking for an experienced and highly capable  General Manager – Construction  to oversee the execution and delivery of the Group's real estate development projects. The GM – Construction will have overall responsibility for coordinating and monitoring construction activities across multiple projects, ensuring that projects are completed  on time, within approved budgets, according to approved designs and specifications, and to the required quality and safety standards . The position will manage and coordinate  site engineers, project teams, architects, consultants, contractors and subcontractors , while providing senior management with timely and accurate project updates. Key Responsibilities 1. Overall Construction Management Oversee construction activities across all ongoing real estate projects of Oriental Group. Monitor progress against approved project schedules, budgets and construction plans. Ensure projects remain on track for timely completion. Identify delays, technical issues and resource constraints and take corrective action. Coordinate construction activities between different projects and ensure proper allocation of manpower and resources. 2. Management of Site Engineers Directly supervise and coordinate all Site Engineers, Project Engineers and relevant technical personnel. Establish clear responsibilities and reporting requirements for each site team. Review daily, weekly and monthly site reports. Monitor site engineers' performance and ensure proper supervision of contractors. Conduct regular site inspections. Ensure site teams follow approved drawings, specifications and construction procedures. 3. Architect & Consultant Coordination Act as the primary coordination point between Oriental Group and appointed architects, structural engineers, MEP consultants and other technical consultants. Ensure architectural and engineering drawings are received, reviewed and issued to site on time. Coordinate resolution of design discrepancies and technical issues. Ensure construction is carried out according to approved drawings and specifications. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and project timelines. 4. Contractor & Subcontractor Management Monitor the performance of main contractors and subcontractors. Ensure contractors meet agreed schedules, quality standards and contractual requirements. Review contractor work progress and identify underperformance. Coordinate contractor meetings and progress reviews. Verify work completion before recommending payments or certifications. Assist management in contractor selection, negotiation and performance evaluation. 5. Project Planning & Scheduling Develop and maintain detailed construction schedules for each project. Establish project milestones and critical deadlines. Track actual progress against planned progress. Identify critical-path activities and potential delays. Develop recovery plans where projects fall behind schedule. Ensure management is informed immediately of any significant deviation from the approved schedule. 6. Cost & Budget Monitoring Monitor construction expenditure against approved project budgets. Coordinate with Finance, Procurement and Project teams to control construction costs. Review material requirements and major procurement requirements. Monitor variations, additional works and contractor claims. Identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality. Ensure unauthorized expenditure or variations are not undertaken without proper approval. 7. Quality Control Ensure construction work complies with approved drawings, specifications and applicable standards. Establish appropriate quality-control procedures across project sites. Monitor quality of structural, architectural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC and finishing works. Ensure defective or substandard work is identified and rectified. Conduct regular inspections of critical construction activities. 8. Site Reporting & Management Information The GM will be responsible for ensuring that  accurate and timely project reporting  reaches senior management. Reports should include: Overall project progress Progress against schedule Construction photographs Key activities completed Upcoming activities Material requirements Labour and manpower status Contractor performance Budget vs. actual expenditure Major variations Delays and reasons Technical issues Risks requiring management attention Reports must be submitted according to an agreed  daily, weekly and monthly reporting system . 9. Procurement & Materials Coordination Coordinate with Procurement and Stores to ensure construction materials are available when required. Review project material requirements and planned procurement schedules. Ensure material deliveries are aligned with construction schedules. Monitor material wastage and unauthorized use. Coordinate with the Group's internal audit/store-control functions regarding material verification where necessary. 10. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure appropriate health and safety practices are maintained at all construction sites. Ensure contractors and site personnel comply with applicable safety requirements. Identify major site safety risks and ensure corrective measures are implemented. Ensure necessary approvals, permits and technical documentation are maintained. Management Responsibilities The GM – Construction will be expected to establish a  professional project management structure  across Oriental Group's real estate portfolio, including: Group Director / MD ↓ GM – Construction ↓ Project Managers / Site Engineers ↓ Contractors / Subcontractors / Site Teams The GM should create a standardized system for  project scheduling, site reporting, contractor monitoring, material requirements, quality control and management reporting  across all projects. Candidate Profile Education: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering is required. Master's degree in Construction Management, Project Management or a related field will be an advantage. PMP or other relevant professional qualifications will be an advantage. Experience: 8–15 years of relevant construction/project management experience. Experience managing  multiple real estate or building construction projects simultaneously  is strongly preferred. Experience with residential, commercial or mixed-use developments will be an advantage. Previous experience managing Site Engineers, Project Managers, contractors and consultants is required. Required Skills Strong knowledge of building construction and project execution. Excellent project planning and scheduling ability. Strong understanding of architectural, structural and MEP coordination. Strong contractor and consultant management skills. Good understanding of construction costing and quantity control. Excellent reporting and documentation skills. Strong Excel and project-management software skills. Ability to identify construction delays and develop recovery plans. Strong leadership and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Personal Attributes The ideal candidate should be: Highly organized and disciplined Strong enough to hold contractors and site engineers accountable Proactive in identifying problems before they become major issues Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously Strong in follow-up and execution Commercially aware and conscious of project costs Technically competent but also capable of communicating effectively with senior management Honest, reliable and capable of working independently Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The GM – Construction will primarily be evaluated on: Projects delivered within approved timelines Construction cost control against approved budgets Quality of completed projects Contractor and subcontractor performance Accuracy and timeliness of project reporting Reduction in construction delays Effective coordination between architects, consultants and site teams Material and manpower planning Number and severity of unresolved site issues Overall project execution and handover performance What We Are Looking For Oriental Group is looking for a  strong execution-oriented construction professional , rather than someone who only manages paperwork. The successful candidate should be capable of visiting sites, challenging contractors, coordinating architects and consultants, supervising Site Engineers, identifying delays and cost overruns, and providing senior management with a  clear and accurate picture of every project's actual status . The GM will effectively be the  person responsible for ensuring that Oriental Group's real estate projects move from drawings to completed buildings efficiently, on schedule, within budget and to the required standard. Compensation:  Competitive salary based on experience and capability. Additional:  Performance-based incentives may be considered based on project delivery, cost savings and successful completion of projects.

job_description: Project Summary: Bangladesh is highly vulnerable to climate change, experiencing impacts such as drought, salinity intrusion, floods, and cyclones. Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion (HI) has been working in Bangladesh since 1997, focusing on creating sustainable changes to ensure the rights and inclusion of people with disabilities in society. HI is an independent and impartial aid organization working in Bangladesh in poverty, exclusion, conflict, and disaster situations. As one of the key organizations in the disability sector, HI has a wide range of projects that assist in promoting the inclusion of persons with disabilities and their issues in emergency and development contexts, building the capacities of local stakeholders, and reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. HI`s multi-sectoral mobile units (MU) and static method are currently working in 15 camps located in both Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas and surrounding host areas, providing comprehensive services in physical rehabilitation, primary health care, protection, and MHPSS. Operational Thematic: Livelihood, Health and Rehabilitation, Protection, Inclusion, Education, and Atlas Logistics.

job_description: Project:   The meaningful Participation and Inclusion of Children and Youth with Disabilities in all domain of CBR. Reporting To:   Project Coordinator / CBR Officer. Organization Overview:   Dipshikha  is a renowned non-governmental organization (NGO) in Bangladesh. Dipshikha was initiated by a group of social workers, school teachers and youth in 1978 in a village called Rudrapur, Dinajpur. Dipshikha is a Bengali word meaning, "Spark of Light". It is a rural development, non-government, non-political, non-profit voluntary organization. Dipshikha- a sparkle, commits itself to poverty alleviation, establishment of equal opportunities, peace and justice by ensuring formational education, appropriate agriculture, hygiene, sanitation, skills promotion and supports for income generation adjustable as time requires for the development of the poor, marginalized and deprived of the rural, semi-urban and urban communities in descending priority. Dipshikha with a team of dedicated, skilled and competent workers cherishes and practices the principles of human dignity, ethical values, participation, team-work, mutual respect and inter-religious harmony with clearly defined policies. Dipshikha is going to implement a project named " The Meaningful Participation and Inclusion of Children and Youth with Disabilities in All Domains of Community-Based Rehabilitation (CBR)"  in Dinajpur district which is Financially and Technically supported by the Liliane Fonds-The Netherlands and Centre for Disability in Development (CDD). This collaboration between the Liliane Fonds and CDD highlights the importance of empowering Children and Youth with Disabilities and integrating their needs into mainstream community development. By addressing barriers and fostering inclusion, the project will contribute to building more equitable and accessible societies. Job Overview:   The CBR Worker will be directly involved in the field-level implementation of activities aimed at promoting the inclusion and empowerment of children and youth with disabilities across all domains of CBR. This role requires engaging with families, communities, and local stakeholders to ensure access to education, health, livelihood opportunities, and social participation for persons with disabilities. Job Location:  The job is based in Birol and Kaharol Upazila of Dinajpur district but with regular travel to upazila and union level for implementation of project activities smoothly. Key Responsibilities: Sensitize the community to change perceptions toward disability through advocacy and community engagement. Support in conducting accessibility assessments for community schools in collaboration with the community. Facilitate the early identification of disabilities and early intervention measures. Promote mainstreaming and inclusion of children with disabilities in schools. Mobilize local communities to engage in and participate in Community-Based Rehabilitation (CBR) activities. Within the framework of the CBR matrix, work with families and communities to identify and implement sustainable measures to empower persons with disabilities. Collaborate with families and communities to undertake activities that prevent disabilities, including but not limited to prevention talks, identification, referrals, and follow-ups tailored to families' needs and questions. Conduct home visits for persons with disabilities and provide training to improve their skills and abilities to participate in family and social life. Provide social support to children with disabilities and their families. Identify and refer children with disabilities in need of care to appropriate services. Follow up with persons referred for services and care. Encourage communities to create inclusive economic empowerment opportunities. Participate in the planning, organization, and reporting of community outreach activities. Collaborate with local government services and authorities to provide services to persons with disabilities by sharing reports and information. Work with NGOs to deliver sustainable interventions for children with disabilities. Collaborate with persons with disabilities by involving them in program activities. Undertake local resource mobilization initiatives to benefit children and youth with disabilities. Sensitize households and communities about Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) issues and Mental Health (MH). Identify and refer individuals suspected of having ENT or mental health issues to appropriate health facilities. Sensitize households and communities on basic hygiene and sanitation practices. Perform other duties as assigned. Complete individual rehabilitation plans (IRPs) using logbooks aligned with the International Classification of Functioning, Disability, and Health (ICF). Arrange skills training and capital support for youth with disabilities and their caregivers to start enterprises at the community level. Support the organization of medical camps in the community. Assist in forming Community Resource Centers, Youth Panels, and Student Forums. Facilitate training programs at the community level. Conduct community-level advocacy to promote the rights of children and youth with disabilities. Maintain child record datasheets. Safeguarding: Ensure safe programming in the planning, implementation, monitoring, and identification of children and youth with disabilities throughout the project period. Adhere to the Do no Harm principles across the entire steps of the project within the Program Management Cycle. Diversity and Inclusion :   Dipshikha   values diversity in the workplace and is dedicated to being an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and strongly encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply, including Persons with Disabilities, Women, Third Gender, and members of Indigenous communities.

job_description: Job Context:  Sentry Security Services Ltd. is looking for an experienced, commercially minded and result-oriented finance professional for the position of Manager – Accounts & Finance. The incumbent will be responsible for managing the company`s day-to-day accounting and financial operations, financial reporting, budgeting, cash-flow management, receivables and payables, payroll-related financial controls, taxation/VAT coordination, audit support and internal financial controls. The position will work closely with the Managing Director/Management, Finance & Accounts Team, HR & Administration, Operations, Procurement, Sales & Business Development and external auditors, banks and regulatory authorities. The successful candidate should have strong hands-on experience in accounting and financial management and the ability to manage finance operations for a large, service-oriented organization with multiple clients and operational locations. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial & Accounting Management Manage the day-to-day Accounts & Finance functions of Sentry Security Services Ltd. Ensure proper recording, classification and reconciliation of all financial transactions. Supervise general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash and bank transactions. Ensure timely preparation and review of vouchers, journals, ledgers and supporting documentation. Maintain accurate and complete books of accounts in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies. Review monthly closing activities and ensure timely completion of accounting processes. Ensure proper documentation and authorization of financial transactions. 2. Financial Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management reports. Prepare income statements, balance sheets, cash-flow statements and other financial schedules. Provide management with accurate and timely financial information for decision-making. Prepare financial analysis relating to revenue, costs, profitability, receivables, expenses and cash flow. Develop management dashboards and financial performance reports where required. Identify significant variances and recommend corrective actions. client onboarding. 3. Budgeting & Financial Planning Coordinate preparation of the annual operating budget. Assist management in preparing financial forecasts and business plans. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets. Analyze budget variances and recommend cost-control measures. Prepare financial projections for new contracts, projects and business opportunities. Support management in assessing the financial viability and profitability of new contracts. 4. Accounts Receivable & Client Billing Supervise timely preparation and submission of client invoices. Ensure accurate billing in accordance with contractual terms. Monitor outstanding receivables and maintain an updated collection schedule. Coordinate with the Sales, Operations and Client-Service Teams regarding billing discrepancies. Follow up on overdue receivables and support timely collection. Prepare monthly receivables ageing reports. Monitor client advances, security deposits, adjustments and other receivable balances. 5. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management Supervise vendor and supplier payments. Verify invoices, supporting documents, approvals and contractual terms before payment. Maintain accurate accounts payable ageing. Ensure payments are made according to approved payment schedules. Coordinate with Procurement and Administration regarding vendor-related financial matters. Maintain proper records of supplier balances and payment commitments. 6. Cash & Bank Management Monitor daily cash and bank balances. Prepare cash-flow forecasts and ensure adequate liquidity for operational requirements. Supervise bank reconciliation statements. Coordinate with banks regarding account operations, statements, payment instruments and other banking matters. Monitor bank charges, interest, loans and other financial transactions. Maintain appropriate cash-management controls. 7. Payroll & Employee-Related Financial Control Coordinate with HR and Payroll Teams to ensure accurate and timely salary processing. Review payroll-related financial information and supporting schedules. Ensure proper accounting of salaries, allowances, bonuses, deductions and employee-related liabilities. Coordinate financial arrangements relating to employee benefits and statutory payments. Ensure payroll-related reconciliations are completed on time. 8. VAT, Tax & Regulatory Compliance Supervise accounting support for applicable VAT and income-tax compliance. Coordinate preparation and submission of relevant VAT/tax returns and statements with the responsible tax/VAT professionals. Ensure proper maintenance of VAT and tax documentation. Monitor withholding tax/TDS/TCS requirements as applicable. Maintain records required for tax/VAT audits and regulatory inspections. Liaise with external tax/VAT consultants and relevant authorities when required. 9. Internal Control & Compliance Establish and strengthen internal financial controls. Ensure proper segregation of duties and authorization procedures. Monitor compliance with company financial policies and procedures. Identify financial control weaknesses and recommend improvements. Minimize financial errors, unauthorized transactions and potential fraud risks. Conduct periodic review of financial processes and supporting documentation. Ensure proper safeguarding of company assets and financial records management informed of significant changes in applicable financial, VAT and tax requirements. 10. Audit Management Coordinate internal and external audit activities. Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents and financial information. Respond to audit queries and coordinate timely resolution of audit observations. Maintain proper audit trails and supporting documentation. Follow up on implementation of agreed audit recommendations. 11. Cost Control & Profitability Analysis Monitor operational and administrative expenses. Analyze cost structures of different service contracts and business units. Support management in determining service profitability and cost efficiency. Analyze manpower-related costs, overtime, allowances and other major operational expenses. Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising service quality. Prepare contract-wise or client-wise profitability analysis where required. 12. Security Services Contract Financial Management Review financial aspects of security-service contracts before implementation. Assist management in evaluating manpower costs, statutory costs, allowances, bonuses and other contract-related expenses. Monitor contract revenue versus operational costs. Ensure timely billing according to agreed contract terms. Highlight contracts with significant margin pressure, delayed payments or financial risks. Support the Operations and Business Development Teams with financial information for quotations and proposals. 13. MIS & Management Support Prepare regular financial MIS for senior management. Develop financial KPIs and dashboards. Provide management with financial analysis and recommendations. Support strategic decision-making through accurate financial information. Prepare ad-hoc financial reports and analysis as required by management. 14. Team Management Supervise, guide and develop the Accounts & Finance Team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance. Establish appropriate accounting procedures and reporting timelines. Train team members on accounting systems, internal controls and company procedures. Conduct performance reviews and recommend training or development requirements. 15. Other Responsibilities Coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants, vendors, clients and regulatory authorities as required. Support management in financial due diligence for new business opportunities. Assist in implementation or improvement of accounting/ERP systems. Ensure confidentiality and security of financial information. Perform other duties assigned by the Management.

job_description: Project Brief:  Ipas has been working successfully in Bangladesh to improve and expand women’s and girls’ access to safe, high-quality reproductive health services. However, the need for sexual and reproductive services, particularly safe Menstrual Regulation (MR), Post Abortion Care (PAC), is still tremendous. Ipas Bangladesh has been working with UNFPA since October 2017 in Cox’s Bazar to support the health of forcedly displaced Myanmar nationals. Since then, UNFPA developed implementing partnership with Ipas to establish the MR, PAC and FP services for the most affected refugee camp areas of Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas of Cox’s Bazar District. The overall goal of the project is to improve the availability and accessibility of quality FP, MR and PAC services at service delivery points for women and girls of Rohingya refugees and host community in Bangladesh and increase the awareness for the Rohingya community. The specific objectives of the project are as follows: To translate the “Family Planning Strategy for the Rohingya Refugee Crisis 2026–2030” into action through a collaborative process. This includes developing an action plan, strengthening coordination mechanisms, and supporting effective implementation. To build and strengthen the capacity of clinical service providers working in humanitarian settings through training, onsite support, and clinical mentoring focused on contraceptive and MR/PAC services. To ensure that project-supported facilities have well-trained, dedicated providers who are equipped with essential resources and able to deliver quality SRHR services, with a focus on FP, MR, and PAC. To improve awareness among the Rohingya community by engaging Community Health Workers, religious leaders, and local influencers by strengthening their capacity on SRH services to help promote positive health-seeking behavior among this displaced population. To strengthen coordination and collaboration among DGFP, DGHS, DGIF, UN agencies, RRRC, and CICs to support effective project implementation. Job Summary:  The Clinical Trainer and Mentor will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality comprehensive MR, PAC, and FP services at camp-level project facilities in line with national standard protocols for humanitarian settings. She will ensure the availability of required medical instruments, essential medicines, logistics, and commodities at facility level to create an enabling environment for Mid-level Service Providers (MLPs) to deliver comprehensive SRH services. She will plan monthly visit plan to the project sites to provide regular mentoring and monitoring support to project MLPs. She will organize and facilitate capacity-building activities based on project needs, and will accurately document event and performance data in accordance with organizational protocols. The Clinical Trainer and Mentor will also contribute to the planning and implementation of project clinical activities as outlined in the work plan and donor requirements. Additionally, she will maintain effective coordination with government counterparts (RRRC, CIC, CS, DDFP) and other relevant stakeholders as required by the project. Reports to:  Advisor I- SRHR Program Duration of Contract :  September 2026 to December 2026 (renewable depending on the funding availability and performance) Key Responsibilities   A. Capacity Building Support the development of the annual training plan, and help design and coordinate training programs, including preparing training materials. Conduct theoretical sessions and clinical practice sessions, and facilitate trainings as needed based on project demand. Provide follow-up and on-site mentoring to trainees, and offer on-the-job mentoring support to Mid-Level Providers to strengthen skills, ensure skill retention, and improve service quality. Assist the supervisor and project team in preparing training and event reports.   B. Clinical Mentoring and Monitoring Provide technical guidance to Ipas’s seconded MLPs deployed through the implementing partner (BAPSA) as well as the SBCC team. Ensure quality implementation at project sites by offering mentoring and monitoring support, using structured project and service monitoring tools. Plan and carry out joint monitoring visits as needed. Maintain and regularly update a trainee and competency database for humanitarian settings, covering all individuals who received clinical training and mentoring support from Ipas. Conduct Service Progress Reviews (SPR), provide constructive feedback to service providers, and share findings with the project team to guide planning and corrective actions. Support the facilitation of Whole Site Orientation (WSO), VCAT sessions, and Infection Prevention orientations at the facility level to promote a supportive and enabling environment for service delivery.   C. Clinical Service Provision The Clinical Trainer and Mentor will ensure the delivery of high-quality SRHR services including  MR, PAC and FP services at camp-level project facilities. She will provide services as needed to support the MLPs at facility level in line with standard protocols and guidelines while ensuring proper client counselling and maintaining infection prevention throughout service delivery.   D. Facility Readiness The Clinical Trainer and Mentor will ensure that medical instruments, essential medicines, logistics, and commodities are available at facility level so Mid-Level Providers can deliver comprehensive SRHR services within their respective facilities. She will verify that all job aids, manuals, and IEC materials relevant to project are in place and properly displayed to support smooth and effective service provision. She will maintain regular communication with the Facility In-Charge, service providers, and staff of other partner NGOs of that facility to help create an enabling environment for delivering SRHR services.   E. Coordination with internal and external stakeholders: Support the project team members in organizing program review and coordination meeting as per project work plan. Attend need based different meetings with donor, stakeholders, orientation coordination meetings Reports to Supervisor and Project Manager about workflow, deadlines, reports Performs other duties as assigned by the supervisor   F. Documentation and Reporting The Clinical Trainer and Mentor will record performance data in the approved reporting format and share it with the designated manager according to the guidelines. She will ensure all client cards are completed accurately and review and analyze service data to support performance improvement. The Clinical Trainer and Mentor will report any Serious Adverse Events as per organizational protocol without delay.   G. Performs other duties as assigned by the Supervisor

job_description: Eco-Social Development Organization (ESDO) started its journey in 1988 with a noble vision to stand in solidarity with the poor and marginalized. Being a people` centered organization, ESDO envisioned for a society which will be free from inequality and injustice, a society where no child will cry from hunger and no life will be ruined by poverty. Near about three decades of relentless efforts to make this happen, ESDO has embraced new grounds and opened up new horizons to help the disadvantaged and vulnerable people to bring meaningful and lasting changes in their lives. During this long span, ESDO has adapted with the changing situation and provided the most time-bound services especially for the poor and disadvantaged. A community focused and people centered approach has been adapted by ESDO while consideration was given to the national policy and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as its guiding principle. ESDO is one of the most dynamic organizations expanding its development interventions across 422 upazilas under 56 districts of Bangladesh covering over 10 million poor and vulnerable people. ESDO is going to implement a UNICEF-supported project titled “Provide quality, inclusive skills development and Myanmar Curriculum STEM education for adolescent learners aged 15-18, and portable skills training for education volunteers in Cox`s Bazar” in Rohingya camps of Ukhia, Cox’s Bazar. The project aims to improve access to quality foundational literacy numeracy (FLN), trade skills, employability skills, leadership skills, entrepreneurship training, STEM Education and portable skills opportunities for Rohingya adolescents and youth through multi-Purpose Centers (MPCs), Science & IT Labs, and SKILFO-based portable skills interventions. The Skills Development Trade Expert is the technical authority for one of the project`s six trade courses and is responsible for the day-to-day quality of trade instruction, the technical development of the volunteer Trade and Entrepreneurship Skills Instructor, the credibility of learner competency assessment, and the market relevance of what is being taught in the lab. The position guides and monitors instructors delivering the assigned trade across the multi-purpose centres, strengthens vocational education and training (VET) pedagogy, drives the development of contextually appropriate and low-cost teaching and learning materials, and ensures learner assessment is conducted in line with best practice in skills development. The six Trade Experts together own the technical quality backbone of the project`s trade delivery, one for each of the six trades offered under the project. The Skills Development Trade Expert will work under the direct supervision of the Market Linkage and Business Development Specialist, with dotted-line coordination to the Adolescent Development Specialist on VET pedagogy and instructor development, and will coordinate closely with the Skills Development Field Officer, Skills Development Field Assistants, volunteer Rohingya and host-community Trade and Entrepreneurship Skills Instructors, the Inclusion Associate, the PSEA, CSG and AAP Officer, the Information Management Manager, the Warehouse Associate, and master craftspersons and industry practitioners engaged under the project. One trade expert will be recruited for each of the following trade offerings (the relevant NSDA course will be matched for qualification assessment). • Tailoring & Reusable Sanitary Pad Production • Soap & Hygiene Product Production Reporting to: Market Linkage & Business Development Specialist Job Responsibilities A. Trade-Specific Technical Guidance, Quality Assurance, and Lab Standards Provide day-to-day technical guidance to the volunteer Rohingya and host-community Trade and Entrepreneurship Skills Instructors delivering the assigned trade across the multi-purpose centres, so that instruction is technically sound and competency based. Conduct regular workshop and classroom monitoring visits to observe delivery, verify practical standards, check tool and equipment condition, and confirm that occupational health and safety (OHS) protocols are being followed. Uphold competency-based training standards include the appropriate balance of theory and practice, disciplined workflow, quality of finished products, and workshop organization. Promote safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible use of tools, materials, machinery, and consumables across every workshop delivering the assigned trade. Support development and refinement of training schedules, practical exercises, and demonstration sessions. Promote safe and effective use of tools, equipment, and training materials. B. Instructor Coaching, VET Pedagogy Improvement, and Performance Assessment Coach, mentor, and support the volunteer Trade and Entrepreneurship Skills Instructors on the assigned trade, providing on-the-job guidance, demonstration, and structured feedback that lifts instructor practice over the project cycle. Improve VET pedagogy at instructor level, including practical demonstration technique, sequencing of theory and practice, competency-based instruction, learner-centred facilitation, and adolescent-appropriate delivery. Deliver technical refresher training, In-Learning Circles (ILCs), and Training of Trainers sessions as part of the instructor development calendar coordinated by the Market Linkage and Business Development Specialist and Adolescent Development Specialist. Conduct structured performance assessment of Trade and Entrepreneurship Skills Instructors through classroom observation, teaching demonstration, and technical review, and support Performance Improvement Plans in coordination with the Information Management Manager and HR and Admin Associate where quality concerns are identified. C. Learner Assessment, Skills Evaluation, and Competency Standards Ensure learner assessment for the assigned trade is designed and conducted in line with best practice in skills development, using competency-based methods, practical demonstrations, product-based tasks, portfolio evidence, and rubrics that credibly measure what learners can do. Conduct or verify practical assessments, competency evaluations, and end-of-course examinations for learners of the assigned trade, ensuring fairness, transparency, and alignment with the project`s assessment framework. Support learner progression, graduation, and certification decisions on the basis of demonstrated competency, and organize practical examinations, exhibitions, and product showcases as part of the assessment cycle. Contribute to development and refinement of assessment tools, rubrics, and marking guides for the assigned trade. D. Curriculum, Low-Cost Learning Materials, and Continuous Improvement Support development, adaptation, and continuous improvement of training modules, session plans, practical exercises, and demonstration protocols for the assigned trade. Lead the development of low-cost, contextually appropriate teaching and learning materials, samples, product templates, and demonstration aids that raise workshop quality without stretching the budget. job_description: Background:  The Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System for Africa and Asia (RIMES) is an international and inter-governmental institution that is owned and managed by its 48 Member and Collaborating States for building capacities in the generation and application of user-relevant multi-hazard early warning information, for resources and risks management. RIMES was established on 30 April 2009 through the signing by collaborating countries of the RIMES regional cooperation agreement. RIMES was registered with the United Nations under Article 102 of the UN Charter on 1 July 2009. RIMES Headquarters operates from its regional early warning center, located at the campus of the Asian Institute of Technology in Pathumthani, Thailand; country offices have been established strategically. RIMES` purpose is to provide early warning services according to differing needs and demands of its Member and Collaborating States, for enhanced preparedness and response to, and mitigation of, natural hazards. RIMES` approach is end-to-end, capacitating institutions and communities across the four broad and inter-connected components of the early warning/climate information value chain. Position Description:  The Nature-Based Solutions Specialist will provide technical leadership and hands-on support for community-based NbS, ecosystem-based risk reduction, hazard and vulnerability mapping, anticipatory action planning, capacity building, monitoring, and documentation under the SURAKKHA project. The Specialist will work closely with the RIMES technical team, Save the Children, local implementing partners, the Department of Agricultural Extension, Disaster Management Committees, Local Government Institutions, relevant government agencies, and communities. Duty station:  The position is based at Dhaka, RIMES satellite office, with frequent travel to field sites (Bandarban, Rangamati, Khagrachhari, and Chattogram) as required. The job location may be adjusted if required by the project. Major Duties and Responsibilities: Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Provide overall technical leadership for the planning, design, and implementation of community-based NbS for landslide and flash flood risk reduction, including slope stabilization, reforestation and agroforestry, drainage and watershed management, and soil and erosion control. Develop appropriate methodologies, technical designs, specifications, and quality standards for NbS interventions, drawing on recognized good practice and ensuring that measures are low-cost, locally appropriate, environmentally sound, and maintainable by communities. Guide field implementation through local implementing partners, ensuring technical soundness, value for money, timely delivery, and alignment with the available project budget. Lead participatory hazard, vulnerability, and ecosystem mapping to identify and prioritize intervention sites, integrating community knowledge, local hazard records, socio-economic information, and available scientific and geospatial data. Make full use of existing hazard, exposure, and vulnerability information and avoid duplication of data collection; produce practical, decision-ready mapping outputs to guide site selection, resource allocation, and replication. Provide technical inputs to the project`s broader exposure, vulnerability, and impact-based forecasting products, early action protocols, simulation exercises, and anticipatory action planning as required. Facilitate inclusive engagement of communities, local government, disaster management committees, indigenous groups, women, youth, persons with disabilities, and older persons in planning, implementation, and participatory monitoring. Design and deliver hands-on, scenario-based capacity-building activities for communities, local institutions, and partner staff on the design, maintenance, monitoring, and replication of NbS interventions. Support the integration of NbS and risk-reduction content into farmer field school and agro-meteorological extension activities, including locally appropriate guidance for farmers and extension staff. Establish and maintain a simple monitoring framework aligned with the project results framework, and track progress, effectiveness, beneficiary coverage, good practices, lessons learned, and opportunities for replication. Prepare clear technical reports, presentations, learning briefs, knowledge products, and inputs to project deliverables as required by the Supervisor. Other tasks Able and willing to travel to project and pilot locations and undertake other work-related travel as required. Organize and/or participate in project team meetings, coordination platforms, technical working groups, and knowledge-sharing events at community, district, and national levels. Undertake any other relevant work necessary for the successful implementation, monitoring, documentation, and reporting of project-related activities, as assigned by the Supervisor. Expected Outputs: Monthly progress report on assigned tasks Activity reports for specific events Report To:  Country Program Lead, Bangladesh. Contract Duration:  The contract will be for 12 months & may be extended for the remainder of the project period depending on satisfactory performance and continued project need.

job_description: Position Purpose The MEAL Manager for the Dhaka Office provides strategic leadership and oversight of MEAL functions across all programs and operational areas. The postholder will lead and manage a team of MEAL professionals, including the MEAL Officer and Research & Learning Consultant, ensuring alignment with The Earth MEAL standards and sector best practices. The MEAL Manager will also be responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive MEAL strategy, strengthening internal MEAL systems, ensuring compliance with donor and organizational requirements, and fostering a learning culture across the various projects operated by The Earth. The role requires excellent leadership, analytical, and coordination skills to navigate the complex operating environment and drive impactful change. Ensure MEAL systems and processes are standardized, robust, and user-friendly, enabling effective data collection, analysis, and reporting. Support partners in establishing their internal MEAL systems, M&E plans, and data-quality management. job_description: Job Context: AK Nur International Real Estate Agency Ltd. is looking for an experienced, responsible, confident, and target-oriented professional for the position of Assistant Manager – Real Estate Sales. Support management in developing and implementing effective sales strategies. Identify performance gaps and provide practical guidance to improve team results. Lead Generation and Business Development: Generate potential clients through phone calls, social media, referrals, networking, field marketing, existing databases, and other appropriate channels. Build and maintain a strong professional network within the real estate sector. Identify serious, qualified, and financially capable property buyers. Follow up with old leads and inactive clients to identify new sales opportunities. Contribute ideas for property promotions, campaigns, and client acquisition strategies. Support the company in expanding its property listings and client database. Property Information and Listing Management: Collect, verify, review, and maintain accurate property information. Communicate with property owners and developers to confirm property details, prices, availability, documents, and transaction conditions. Coordinate with the content and marketing teams to ensure accurate property advertisements. Protect confidential client, property, and transaction information. Property Visits and Client Meetings: Arrange and coordinate property visits with prospective clients. Accompany clients during property visits when required. Negotiation and Transaction Closing: Negotiate property prices, service charges, commissions, and transaction terms between buyers and sellers. Maintain fairness, professionalism, confidentiality, and transparency during negotiations. Support clients in reaching mutually acceptable transaction terms. Arrange buyer-owner meetings and assist throughout the negotiation process. Coordinate with management and relevant parties during transaction closing. Support the preparation and collection of necessary documents and information. Ensure proper follow-up until the property sale, purchase, or rental transaction is successfully completed. Assist in resolving transaction-related issues where necessary. Reporting and Record Management: Maintain accurate and updated records of: Property listings Client information New leads Follow-up activities Property visits Buyer-owner meetings Negotiations Successful transactions Pending transactions Monthly revenue Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports. Report sales progress, client responses, challenges, and opportunities to management. Maintain proper documentation of sales activities and transaction status. Ensure the accuracy, regularity, and professionalism of all submitted reports. Use Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, CRM systems, or other company-approved tools for data management. Additional Responsibilities: Maintain a professional image and represent the company responsibly. Follow company policies, instructions, and ethical standards. Coordinate with the administration, marketing, content, legal, and management teams when required. Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, workshops, and performance reviews. Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by management. Sales Targets and Performance Evaluation: This is a highly target-oriented position. The selected candidate will be responsible for achieving both individual and team-based monthly sales and revenue targets. Performance will be evaluated based on the following criteria: Number of quality leads generated Number of serious and qualified buyers identified Quality and consistency of client follow-ups Client response and engagement rate Number of property visits arranged Number of completed property visits Number of buyer-owner meetings conducted Number of successful property sales Number of successful rental transactions Monthly revenue generation Achievement of individual sales targets Achievement of team-based sales targets Accuracy and regularity of sales reports Quality of team supervision and leadership Property database development Customer satisfaction Professional conduct, punctuality, and discipline Contribution to the company’s overall sales growth

job_description: BADAS Centre for Health Research and Implementation (BADAS-CHRI) is a collaborative research centre between the Diabetic Association of Bangladesh (BADAS), University College London Institute for Global Health (UCL-IGH), UK, and Department of Health Sciences, University of York, UK. Operating since 2002, BADAS-CHRI addresses critical health issues in maternal and child health, diabetes, hypertension, depression, and injuries through research and implementation projects. BADAS-CHRI is seeking qualified candidates for the position of Intervention Officer for the PECAN (Participatory Engagement for City Communities Against NCD Risk in Bangladesh and Nepal) project (https://www.ucl.ac.uk/global-health/research/z-research/participatory-engagement-city-communities-against-ncd-risk-bangladesh-and-nepal). This position will be based at CHRI's District Office in Faridpur Municipality. PECAN is a cross-country study implemented in Faridpur Municipality, Bangladesh, and Nagarjun Municipality, Nepal, in collaboration with implementing partner HERD International of Nepal. The study aims to assess the burden of non-communicable disease (NCD) risk and to co-create, implement, and evaluate community-led interventions using the Participatory Learning and Action (PLA) method, addressing socio-environmental risk factors across age, gender, and socio-economic groups. A particular focus is on promoting physical activity among older women. Using a mixed-methods approach to adapt and evaluate PLA interventions, and engaging local stakeholders and civil society, the project generates evidence-based strategies to inform policymakers, practitioners, and citizens and to advance health equity and resilience in urban South Asia. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled intervention implementer, manager, and monitor to apply and develop their skills with an international research team. The Intervention Officer shall be responsible for the following roles: Job descriptions Familiarize with the study area, community context, and relevant stakeholders. Support implementation of community-led interventions (NCD Action Groups, women's physical activity groups, and digital health campaign). Manage and supervise field-level trainers, facilitators, and volunteers involved in intervention delivery. Actively monitor who is/isn't participating (by gender, age, socio-economic status) and adjust outreach to keep the intervention aligned with equity principles. Escalate issues (low attendance, community resistance, safety concerns) to the project coordinator promptly. Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager or office from time to time. Maintain activity logs across all interventions. NCD Action Group intervention responsibilities Engage local authorities, decision-makers, and other relevant stakeholders in addressing the social, commercial, environmental, and political determinants of NCDs and their risk factors. Manage and support the community-led action group to function effectively by coordinating, guiding discussions, supporting follow-up, and strengthening members' capacity. Conduct, or supervise facilitators conducting, regular community-led intervention meetings in coordination with the group chairperson and members. Support preparation of meeting agendas, discussions, and documentation of decisions and action points. Support group members in identifying community priorities, developing action plans, and coordinating implementation of activities. Follow up on agreed action points and support communication among group members and stakeholders. Provide technical and logistical support for community-led activities as needed. Physical activity intervention responsibilities Supervise physical activity group facilitators. Coordinate logistics and ensure supply of physical activity materials for PECAN-led women's physical activity groups. Review and follow up on adverse event reports. Oversee delivery of the monthly Q&A and peer support/sharing circle meetings. Digital health intervention responsibilities Support rollout and troubleshooting of the Bangla mHealth messaging component (e.g., verifying message delivery). Monitor delivery rates and troubleshoot failed sends. Log participant opt-outs and complaints. Manage the project/community Facebook page: posting cadence, community replies, moderation, and engagement tracking (reach, shares, comments). Ensure all content follows equity/accessibility principles (low-literacy-friendly visuals, audio options). Flag and escalate any misinformation or negative community response. Contract type and duration The appointment is on a contractual basis. The contract duration shall align with the project's intervention tenure (12-15 months), with renewal or termination based strictly on performance and the continuation of the project.

Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. HI is an independent and impartial aid organization working in Bangladesh in poverty, exclusion, conflict, and disaster situations. With projects in different districts of the country, HI works not only with people with disabilities and other vulnerable populations but also with their families, their communities, and local humanitarian actors to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions, promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights, and provide sustainability in its action. As one of the key organizations in the disability sector, HI has a wide range of projects that assist in promoting the inclusion of persons with disabilities and their issues in emergency and development contexts, building the capacities of local stakeholders, and reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. HI`s multi-sectoral mobile units (MU) and static method are currently working in 15 camps located in both Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas and surrounding host areas, providing comprehensive services in physical rehabilitation, primary health care, protection, and MHPSS. Operational Thematic: Livelihood, Health and Rehabilitation, Protection, Inclusion, Education, and Atlas Logistics.

Presently, HI Bangladesh is implementing projects on integrating disability in community-based disaster risk reduction and response; economic empowerment of extremely poor persons with disabilities; mainstreaming disability in livelihood interventions; support to refugees and surrounding communities, capacity building of professional associations; and support to disabled people`s organizations, among others.

করা। নতুন নতুন প্রজেক্ট বা প্রোগ্রাম এর আওতায় আরও ব্যবসা সম্প্রসারণের জন্য তথ্য সংগ্রহ এবং সেই অনুযায়ী পরিকল্পনা করা। বাজার পরিস্থিতি, প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠানের কার্যক্রম ও মূল্য প্রবণতা বিশ্লেষণ করে তত্ত্বাবধায়ক এর নিকট তথ্য প্রদান করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা, সরকারি বিধি-বিধান ও টেন্ডার সংক্রান্ত আইন-কানুন যথাযথভাবে অনুসরণ ও নিশ্চিত করা। ব্যবস্থাপনা কর্তৃক অর্পিত প্রজেক্ট ও টেন্ডার সংক্রান্ত অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব যথাযথভাবে পালন করা। আরএসএফ ম্যানেজমেন্ট কর্তৃক আরোপিত প্রতিষ্ঠানের স্বার্থ সংশ্লিষ্ট যে কোন কাজ সম্পাদন করা।

job_description: Context: A new integrated healthcare and diagnostics center in Dhaka is preparing for launch. We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to join the founding management team and help take the center from pre-opening stage to commercial readiness. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can work independently, build trusted relationships and drive important work streams to completion. Role goal Your immediate goal is to deliver two critical launch outcomes: obtain the licenses and approvals required for the agreed opening scope, and secure a strong panel of consulting doctors. You will also support equipment procurement and provide market input to the specialist agency leading the center’s brand development. Once the center is ready to open, your role will shift toward sustained business growth through doctor referrals, corporate partnerships and community relationships, supported by junior business development staff. First 3-4 month goals:  complete the required licensing process and secure at least 25 suitable consultants with documented commitments, intended sessions and substantially complete credentials. Phase 1 - Pre-opening mandate Licensing and regulatory approvals Objective:  Own the process from requirements mapping through submission, inspection and final approval. Create and maintain one clear licensing tracker showing requirements, documents, owners, fees, submission dates, inspections, risks, deadlines and renewal dates. Coordinate all approvals applicable to the final service scope. These may include DGHS, city-corporation trade licensing, tax and VAT registrations, Fire Service, Department of Environment, medical-waste arrangements, BAERA radiation approval, DGDA pharmacy licensing and labor or establishment requirements. Prepare complete application packs, collect required signatures and professional documents, submit through the prescribed channels, and retain official receipts and evidence. Ensure that the legal name, address, floor area, service scope, equipment and personnel details are consistent across every submission. Lead follow-up with authorities, arrange inspections and prepare the site team and evidence needed for each visit. Identify missing dependencies, conflicting advice or delay risks early and escalate them with a practical resolution plan. Important:  Process ownership means driving the work end to end. Where regulations require legal, clinical, radiation, pharmacy or other professional sign-off, you will coordinate with the appropriately qualified person. Consultant acquisition and engagement Objective:  Build a credible consultant panel that supports the center’s clinical scope and launch plan. Build a ranked pipeline of approximately 40-60 qualified prospects to secure at least 25 documented commitments. Approach respected consultants across priority specialties, using existing relationships, warm introductions and targeted outreach. Priority areas include medicine, endocrinology, cardiology, nephrology, gastroenterology, respiratory medicine, neurology, physical medicine or orthopedics, women`s health and gynecology, dermatology, pediatrics, and relevant diagnostic or reporting specialties. Arrange meetings and site visits, understand objections, agree intended sessions and keep a live consultant pipeline with clear next actions. Convert verbal interest into an appropriately reviewed letter of intent or agreement covering the role, schedule, commercial terms, attendance and relevant branding requirements. Maintain complete consultant files, including current registrations, qualifications, appointment or consent documents, and any information needed for licensing or clinical privileges. Launch support Objective : Support selected launch work without replacing the specialist owners of procurement and branding. Support equipment procurement by gathering comparable quotations, checking supplier credibility and after-sales support, and flagging gaps in accessories, consumables, training, regulatory support or delivery timelines. Participate in vendor discussions and document commitments, while final purchasing decisions remain with the authorized project team. Provide market, doctor and patient insights to the appointed marketing agency and support launch partnerships. The agency will own brand identity and creative development. Transition to Phase 2 The role will transition when the agreed opening scope has the required licenses and approvals in place, and at least 25 suitable consultants have documented commitments, intended sessions and substantially confirmed credentials. Phase 2 - Ongoing business development 1.Doctor and professional referrals Map and priorities doctors, specialists, clinics, pharmacies and other professional partners within the center’s catchment area. Personally manage key relationships and supervise junior field visits, ensuring that partners understand the center’s services, patient preparation, turnaround times, report access and patient hand-back process. Track active referrers, referral conversion, repeat referrals, specialty coverage and service issues, and act quickly where performance is weak. 2.Corporate and institutional partnerships Build a named pipeline across employers, banks and service companies, educational institutions, residential associations, insurers or TPAs and other suitable organizations in Dhaka. Develop commercially sound proposals for approved services such as employee medicals, executive and chronic-risk programmers, women`s health initiatives and vaccination. Negotiate and close MoUs, service agreements and pilot programmers within approved commercial parameters, with clear terms for scope, rates, scheduling, authorization, credit, invoicing and collection. Monitor utilization, patient experience, margin, receivables, renewal and appropriate center-based follow-up. 3.Team and commercial management Help recruit, train and supervise junior doctor-relations, corporate-sales and field-activation staff. Set coverage plans, visit standards, CRM discipline and weekly coaching routines. Own the business development pipeline, forecast, commercial calendar and performance reporting, with accountability for active referrers, partnerships, conversion, revenue and collections.

Shipment Planning:  Monitor shipment calendars and buyer delivery schedules; prioritize urgent and critical orders; ensure washing completion aligns with finishing, packing, and export timelines; and implement recovery plans for delayed shipments to ensure on-time delivery. 4. Order & WIP Management:  Monitor Work-in-Progress (WIP) across all washing plants; track order status from garment receipt to shipment; identify production bottlenecks affecting production flow; ensure ageing orders receive immediate attention; and maintain optimum WIP levels. 5. Production Monitoring:  Compare actual production against planned output; analyze daily production variances; monitor achievement of production targets; issue corrective action plans for missed targets; and conduct daily production review meetings. 6. Cross-Functional Coordination:  Coordinate closely with Merchandising, Production, Washing Plant Operations, Industrial Engineering (IE), Quality Assurance (QA), Washing Laboratory, Commercial & Export, Logistics, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Stores to ensure seamless execution of production plans and timely order completion. 7. Material & Chemical Readiness:  Ensure garment availability before wash loading; confirm the availability of chemicals, dyes, enzymes, auxiliaries, trims, and packing materials as per the production plan; and coordinate with Procurement and Stores to prevent material shortages. 8. MIS & Reporting:  Prepare and publish Daily Production Plan, Factory Capacity Report, Washing WIP Report, Shipment Status Report, Order Ageing Report, Machine Utilization Report, Production Variance Report, Weekly Planning Dashboard, Monthly KPI Report, and Executive Management MIS to support operational and strategic decision-making. 10. ERP & Planning System Management:  Maintain accurate production data in the ERP system; update production plans in real time; ensure master planning data accuracy; generate automated planning reports and dashboards; and support ERP implementation and continuous system improvement. 11. Continuous Improvement:  Implement Lean Planning practices; reduce production lead time; improve planning accuracy; optimize production flow; minimize waiting time and idle capacity; and actively participate in Kaizen and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Diagnose and rectify faults in motors, VFDs, PLCs, HMIs, MCCs, PCCs, transformers, switchgears, electrical panels, sensors, instrumentation, and control systems. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) of recurring equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Automation & Instrumentation Maintain PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial communication systems, sensors, transmitters, encoders, and process control equipment. Troubleshoot instrumentation related to temperature, pressure, flow, level, pH, conductivity, steam control, humidity, and fabric tension systems. Support automation upgrades, machine modifications, and digitalization initiatives to improve production efficiency. Ensure calibration and accuracy of critical process instruments. অ্যান্ড লস, ব্যালেন্স শিট, ক্যাশ ফ্লো) প্রস্তুত ও উপস্থাপন করা। উৎপাদন এবং ইনভেন্টরি ব্যবস্থাপনা: সকল পণ্যের ইনভেন্টরি লগের সাথে প্রতিদিনের উৎপাদন রিপোর্টের মিল যাচাই ও সমন্বয় করা। উৎপাদনের সঠিক খরচ হিসাব করতে এবং কাঁচামালের অপচয় রোধ করতে কাঁচামাল ক্রয় ও ব্যবহারের নিখুঁত হিসাব রাখা। পে-রোল এবং দৈনন্দিন খরচ: কারখানার সকল শ্রমিক এবং প্রশাসনিক কর্মীদের সাপ্তাহিক/মাসিক বেতন, ওভারটাইম এবং দৈনিক ভাতা পরিচালনা ও প্রদান করা। দৈনন্দিন পেটি ক্যাশ লেনদেন এবং কারখানার পরিচালন ব্যয় তদারকি করা এবং সকল ব্যয় যেন যথাযথভাবে অনুমোদিত ও ভাউচারভুক্ত হয়, তা নিশ্চিত করা। অ্যাকাউন্টস পেয়েবল এবং রিসিভেবল: সাপ্লায়ারদের লেজার অ্যাকাউন্ট পরিচালনা করা, যাতে কাঁচামাল ও লজিস্টিক সাপোর্টের পেমেন্ট সময়মতো সম্পন্ন হয়। অ্যাকাউন্টস রিসিভেবল তদারকি করা, ক্লায়েন্টদের পেমেন্ট ট্র্যাক করা এবং বকেয়া পাওনা সময়মতো আদায় করা নিশ্চিত করা। কমপ্লায়েন্স এবং অডিট: ভ্যাট (VAT), এআইটি (AIT) এবং কর্পোরেট ট্যাক্স সংক্রান্ত সরকারের সকল বিধিবিধান যথাযথভাবে মেনে চলা নিশ্চিত করা। কারখানার অভ্যন্তরে আর্থিক নিয়ন্ত্রণ ব্যবস্থা এবং স্ট্যান্ডার্ড অপারেটিং প্রসিডিউর (SOPs) বাস্তবায়ন ও জোরদার করা। প্রয়োজনীয় নথিপত্র এবং স্বচ্ছ আর্থিক হিসাব প্রদানের মাধ্যমে ইন্টারনাল ও এক্সটারনাল অডিটে (internal and external audit) সহায়তা করা। ব্যাংক রিকনসিলিয়েশন এবং তহবিল ব্যবস্থাপনা: নিয়মিত ব্যাংক রিকনসিলিয়েশন করা এবং কোম্পানির ব্যাংক অ্যাকাউন্টগুলো পরিচালনা করা। কারখানার কার্যক্রম ও সাপ্লাই চেইন স্বাভাবিক রাখতে ভবিষ্যতের ক্যাশ ফ্লো বা নগদ  ১. পদের সারসংক্ষেপ 
 কমি শেফ কিচেন টিমের একটি প্রাথমিক কিন্তু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদ, যেখানে কর্মরত ব্যক্তি শেফ দ্য পার্টি, সু শেফ এবং হেড শেফের তত্ত্বাবধানে খাদ্য প্রস্তুত, উপকরণ প্রস্তুতকরণ এবং কিচেনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করবেন। 
 এই পদের মূল উদ্দেশ্য হলো প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মান, রেসিপি এবং স্বাস্থ্যবিধি অনুসরণ করে খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপগুলো সম্পন্ন করা, কিচেনের কার্যক্রমকে সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা এবং সিনিয়র শেফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 ২. প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য 
 ক) খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি সহায়তা 
 
 শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন খাদ্য উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া, পরিমাপ করা ইত্যাদি)। 
 নির্ধারিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপে সহায়তা করা। 
 খাবারের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখতে সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করা। 
 খাবারের সঠিক উপস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করতে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 খ) কিচেন পরিচালনা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা 
 
 কিচেনের নির্ধারিত কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা। 
 রান্নাঘরের যন্ত্রপাতি, সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ ব্যবহারের পর পরিষ্কার রাখা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা মেনে চলা। 
 
 গ) উপকরণ ব্যবস্থাপনা 
 
 খাদ্য উপকরণ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। 
 উপকরণের সতেজতা ও গুণগত মান পরীক্ষা করা। 
 প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের ঘাটতি হলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। 
 
 ঘ) টিমওয়ার্ক ও সহযোগিতা 
 
 কিচেন টিমের অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সাথে সমন্বয় রেখে কাজ করা। 
 সিনিয়র শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা এবং তাদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 ব্যস্ত সময়ে দ্রুত ও দক্ষতার সাথে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। 
 
 
 ৩. প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা 
 
 কুলিনারি আর্টস বা ফুড প্রোডাকশন বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। 
 রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্যাফে বা হোটেল কিচেনে  কমপক্ষে ১–২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা  থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। 
 খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি, রান্নার মৌলিক কৌশল এবং কিচেন ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নিয়ম সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা। 
 দলগতভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা এবং দায়িত্বশীল মনোভাব। 
 দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ এবং পেশাদারিত্ব বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। 
 
 
 ৪. কর্মপরিবেশ ও কর্মঘণ্টা 
 
 রান্নাঘরের পরিবেশে দীর্ঘ সময় দাঁড়িয়ে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। 
 প্রয়োজনে শিফট ভিত্তিক কাজ, সপ্তাহান্তে বা বিশেষ দিনে কাজ করতে হতে পারে। 
 
 
 ৫. বেতন ও সুবিধা 
 
 প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। 
 প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুবিধা প্রদান করা হবে।
